usedFor: JustCall events start the work, and FreJun places the next call with “Initiate Call” to the specified candidate.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ended” in JustCall, then “Initiate Call” in FreJun
bestTemplate.why: A finished call is a clean point for the next, and the action calls the specified candidate.

watchOut: “Initiate Call” needs a specified candidate, so check that the JustCall event gives you someone to call.
